title: Your Transformer Is Secretly Elastic
summary: 新研究提出"弹性Transformer"方法，无需重训练即可将预训练模型在22M到8B参数范围内按需压缩60%，同时保持平滑性能降级，为异构硬件下的动态算力分配提供了实用解决方案。
summary_en: Researchers introduce a retraining-free method to make pre-trained transformers "elastic" — able to adapt on-the-fly across a continuum of computational budgets. By jointly ranking every individual MLP neuron and attention head on a common scale through differentiable relaxation, the method achieves smooth degradation up to 60% sparsity across 27 vision and text transformer encoders (22M to 8B parameters). For example, pruning DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 to 50% sparsity removes 427M parameters with only 0.8% ImageNet-1k accuracy loss, and at 60% sparsity an AugReg ViT-B/16 achieves up to 1.80× higher throughput and 1.26× lower single-query latency on A100 GPU.
body:
新研究提出"弹性Transformer"方法，无需重训练即可将预训练模型在22M到8B参数范围内按需压缩60%，同时保持平滑性能降级，为异构硬件下的动态算力分配提供了实用解决方案。

论文 / 研究
- Your Transformer Is Secretly Elastic — 无需重训练即可将Transformer压缩60%，在22M–8B参数、27个视觉/文本模型上实现平滑性能降级；A100上吞吐量提升1.8倍。
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20588v1
- Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting for Language Agents — 提出多步动作目标，让语言agent的acting和forecasting协同进化；在5个benchmark超越GRPO和RL基线，ScienceWorld样本效率提升1.9–2倍。
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20597v1
- One Task, Many Interfaces: CIPR提升LLM Agent鲁棒性 — 跨接口策略正则化（CIPR）使LLM agent对界面扰动更鲁棒，恢复10.5%性能损失而不影响原始接口准确率。
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20576v1
- Humanoid Policies权重空间的扩散建模 — 用潜在扩散框架在权重空间直接生成人形控制网络（走路、跳舞、旋转踢），并发现第一层权重编码机器人运动学先验。
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20606v1
